Div.Text: XML UI reference
Declarative UI for OGG admin and client screens. Styles come from Class rules; global widths are set in Appearance and exported via appsettings.json.
Input / Select / Range — 320px (ui_control_width)
Button — 140px (ui_button_width)
Btn / SmallButton — 80px (ui_small_button_width)
label_control_gap — space below Label before the next control (px)
Unless a Class sets an explicit width attribute, controls use these defaults. Input text insets default to L0 R0 T4 B0.
Preview uses your current Appearance and Typography settings.

Div.Text: Layout — root container; width sets design width for layout.
Div — vertical stack of children with optional class padding.
Row — horizontal row (e.g. Input + Button on one line).
Class rule="name" — shared style: padding, margin, colors, height, width, radius, font_size, font_weight, border_color, bg_color, hover_*.
Transparent bg: omit bg_color or set bg_color="transparent". Hover fill only when hover_bg_color is set.
Text — body copy; uses label font size from Typography.
Label — field caption above inputs.
H1 — 2x label size. H2 — 1.5x. H3 — 1.25x.
Input id="..." class="..." placeholder="..." type="password"
TextArea id="..." class="..." rows="4" — multiline edit; height = rows x line height + insets + border.
Native Win32 edit with D2D chrome. Insets from Appearance apply to the text area inside the box.
Select options="fonts" — dropdown of system fonts (Windows).
Range min="0" max="100" value="50" — numeric field with up/down arrows; fires range handler on change.
Slider — legacy trackbar (prefer Range).
Button class="btn-primary" — primary action (default 140px).
Button class="btn-secondary" — same size and shape; only fill/border colors differ.
Btn — compact 80px control (alias SmallButton).
Tab bar: tab_margin_left = underline start; tab_pad_left = text inset from underline.
RadioGroup id="..." value="option" — single selection group.
Radio value="option" — one choice; drawn as a radio circle with label.
Gallery columns="3" — grid of Image children.
Image id="..." src="path" selected="true|false" — clickable thumbnail; selected shows a radio marker.
Model lists use GET unless noted. Image/video generation uses the active provider from Settings → AI.
OpenAI — list models
GET https://api.openai.com/v1/models — Authorization: Bearer key. Used for Validate OpenAI and Refresh OpenAI video models (filters ids containing "sora").
OpenAI — image generation
POST https://api.openai.com/v1/images/generations — JSON: model, prompt, n, size, quality. Response b64_json. Used by Assets → Login Images and Assets → Images.
OpenAI — video generation
POST https://api.openai.com/v1/videos — multipart: prompt, model, size, seconds. Poll GET /v1/videos/{id} until status=completed, then GET /v1/videos/{id}/content for MP4. Used by Assets → Videos.
Gemini — list models

GET https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models — x-goog-api-key header. Image models: generateContent or predict. Video models: generateVideos or Veo ids. Cached until key changes or Refresh.
Gemini — image (Imagen)
POST /v1beta/models/{model}:predict — JSON instances prompt + parameters sampleCount/aspectRatio.
Gemini — image (flash-image)
POST /v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent — generationConfig.responseModalities TEXT,IMAGE.
Gemini — video (Veo)
POST /v1beta/models/{model}:generateVideos — JSON prompt + config aspectRatio/resolution. Poll GET /v1beta/{operation} until done, then download video URI. Used by Assets → Videos.
Long pages scroll with the mouse wheel (ui_scroll_step px per notch). Native controls reposition with scroll.
